explanation:
The central tree retains 74 of the seed's 111 lines, reducing lines by 33.3% and characters by 33.6% (8,771 to 5,822). Five peripherals branch from specific concept lines and add source-grounded detail beyond the seed. Modular structure combines containment and lexical boundaries conceptually; the implementation still stores separate views. Invocation branches describe source-visible orchestration, not observed runtime activations.

Corrections and qualifications: derive.ts preserves relation IDs on inter-component condensation edges, while intra-component relations remain in the original artifact; SCCs include only edge participants. schema.ts permits exported metadata, but the supplied declaration/context code does not populate it. context.ts derives coverage from emitted relation and uncertainty sites, so candidateSites is not an exhaustive AST-site count. sourceJoins.ts returns records without appending them and never emits the schema's ambiguous status.

Evidence comes only from the supplied inputs: declarations.ts supports visibility details; incremental.ts supports reuse and checkpoint behavior; context.ts and schema.ts support evidence handling; derive.ts supports graph projections; sourceJoins.ts supports joins. Imported extractor, metrics, findings, persistence and report implementations were not supplied, so their internal behavior and formulas remain unverified. Positions were checked against actual tree widths and heights; all diagrams are connected with valid 1-based line anchors.
